Aisha: Quick shout — massive thanks to @Marta for staying late and untangling the staging cache issue. Saved the demo today :sparkles:
Marta: Whew, that was a fun one. Glad it got sorted. If anyone needs me to recreate steps I can drop a short runbook tomorrow. :memo:
Devon: Legend. +1 for a runbook. Also coffee/drinks on Marta? :coffee: :tada:
Chris: Seriously, huge help. I owe you one — want me to handle the runbook formatting? I can make a tiny checklist and ops playbook snippet.
Leah: thanksymuch!!! :heart: Saved my talk prep too. Also, can we nominate Marta for next week's shoutouts?
Aisha: Yes please. Also quick poll: snack to thank her? Bagels, doughnuts, or bubble tea? React with :bagel:, :doughnut:, or :bubble_tea: — I'll tally tomorrow.
Marta: No need to fuss but yesss bagels are my weakness. :bagel:
Devon: doughnuts forever. :doughnut:
Chris: bubble tea gang reporting in. :bubble_tea:
ops-bot: Reminder — staging infra autoscaler bumped nodes while issue was active. Logged incident #STG-482.
Aisha: Nice — ops-bot, add that incident link to the runbook when available?
ops-bot: Will do. Tagging @Marta and @Devon in STG-482.
Leah: ok looks like bagels are winning so far. Thanks again Marta, we appreciate you! :raised_hands:
